module: Editor tool "Vehicle AI Path/Plan Debug" (Debug menu of the editor windows). Two tabs: "Route" lets you define a start, an end and waypoints (draggable markers, or the player vehicle's / camera's position), computes the route on the navgraph (gameplay/route/route), displays it with debugDrawer and can send it to the ground markers; "AI Vehicles" lets you select AI vehicles, adjust their parameters (aggression, turnForceCoef, awarenessForceCoef, edgeDist, lookAheadKv, staticFrictionCoefMult), then launch, stop, reposition or reload all the vehicles on the current route or a random 2000 m path. Useful to compare the AI's behavior with different settings.
notes: Disabling dynamic collisions (Enable Dynamic Collisions checkbox) makes the vehicles "ghosts" to compare trajectories; they are re-enabled when the editor is closed (onEditorDeactivated).
On launch, each vehicle receives ai.driveUsingPath({wpTargetList = ..., avoidCars = 'off'}), ai.setAggression, ai.setParameters and the path debug mode.
In tabParams, the branch `elseif type(p[0]) == "boolean"` tests p[0] instead of p[1][0]; since all parameters are numbers, it is never used.
The tool's functions are all local: only the three editor hooks are exported.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor drawing hook: displays the Route / AI Vehicles tabbed window.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Hook emitted when the editor is closed: re-enables dynamic collisions if the tool had disabled them.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook emitted when the editor initializes: registers the window (520x420) and its menu entry in the Debug group.
